# Control Triangle
Part of the control family Classic.

Control creation keywords:
```yaml
Control: Triangle
Variant: <variant name> # (optional) see below for the list of variants
```

The `Variant` keyword is optional and can be one of the following:
- `RightAngled`

Input Properties:
  - AccessibleLabel: Text
  - BorderColor: Color
  - BorderStyle: Enum
      Enum name: BorderStyle
      Enum values: Dashed, Dotted, None, Solid
  - BorderThickness: Number
  - ContentLanguage: Text
  - DisabledFill: Color
  - DisplayMode: Enum
      Enum name: DisplayMode
      Enum values: Disabled, Edit, View
  - Fill: Color
  - FocusedBorderColor: Color
  - FocusedBorderThickness: Number
  - Height: Number
  - HoverFill: Color
  - OnSelect: Boolean
  - PressedFill: Color
  - TabIndex: Number
  - Tooltip: Text
  - Visible: Boolean
  - Width: Number
  - X: Number
  - Y: Number

Additional input properties if a child of a Vertical or Horizontal GroupContainer:
  - AlignInContainer: Enum
      Enum name: AlignInContainer
      Enum values: Center, End, SetByContainer, Start, Stretch
  - FillPortions: Number
  - LayoutMaxHeight: Number
  - LayoutMaxWidth: Number
  - LayoutMinHeight: Number
  - LayoutMinWidth: Number

Additional input properties if a child of a Grid GroupContainer:
  - LayoutGridColumnEnd: Number
  - LayoutGridColumnStart: Number
  - LayoutGridRowEnd: Number
  - LayoutGridRowStart: Number

Output Properties:
  - AccessibleLabel: Text
  - BorderColor: Color
  - BorderStyle: Enum
  - BorderThickness: Number
  - ContentLanguage: Text
  - DisabledFill: Color
  - DisplayMode: Enum
  - Fill: Color
  - FocusedBorderColor: Color
  - FocusedBorderThickness: Number
  - Height: Number
  - HoverFill: Color
  - PressedFill: Color
  - TabIndex: Number
  - Tooltip: Text
  - Visible: Boolean
  - Width: Number
  - X: Number
  - Y: Number
